Kine Protocol is a DeFi protocol that issues synthetic assets backed by over-collateralized deposits. Kine Protocol operates on public blockchains as a smart-contract application without intermediaries.

Deri Protocol is a decentralized derivatives trading protocol. Deri Protocol offers derivative products settled through smart contracts on public blockchains without intermediaries.

Vega is a decentralized derivatives exchange protocol. Vega runs its own blockchain network on which derivative markets are created and traded without intermediaries.

Mango is a decentralized trading and lending platform on the Solana blockchain. Mango combines spot trading, perpetual trading and lending in smart contracts without intermediaries.
